name: Kaisareia
notes: twin city on both banks at the rift narrows; capital because the gap is defensible

name: Anthe
notes: port on the terraces; its harbour is two levels below the town and dry

name: Thessala
notes: south coast; where the grain fleet sails from

name: Nikaia
notes: six hundred people inside walls built for twenty thousand; fields grow between the quarters

name: Vashti
notes: occupied seat in the volcanic field; the Unstained will not take sacraments here

name: Sardeis
notes: burned in the war; the Diadem has not rebuilt it and does not intend to

name: Vetch
notes: the Assembly's seat; timber walls on stone foundations that are much older Act 1: no confirmed quorum among the great houses -- the council currently governing is a rump, not a settled government.

name: Halder
notes: north coast; the sea ices in and the port closes for a third of the year

name: Marrow
notes: the apothecary town; three streets of different widths, and the plague took half of it

name: Ostrova
notes: on the plateau edge; closer to the horse-camps than to Vetch, and it shows

name: Kolm
notes: abandoned to the plague, not to war; nobody has gone back in

name: Lade
notes: first oasis past the wall; the caravanserai where prices rise when a fight is visible

name: Sarn
notes: middle oasis; the League's treaty was signed here and is re-read aloud yearly

name: Kesh
notes: last oasis before the river valley; where the road's tolls are actually collected

name: Anbar
notes: the lending houses; grain bought on credit against a harvest nobody has seen

name: Nirash
notes: delta city; older than the Diadem's oldest record of itself

name: Eresh
notes: a mound with a modern village on top; the city underneath is still being dug out of it

name: Sindar
notes: monsoon port; sells grain to both sides and does not pretend otherwise

name: Pelagos
notes: fisher commune; the saint lives on the next island and they feed him

name: the stranded harbour
notes: on the middle terrace, high above the waterline; the renunciants live in it
